title: Consume European White Flowers isolated values
changes: Publish a selected 20-halfword row and one byte while preserving separately owned roots and fallback for other selectors.
validation: Wine readers pass four original setup, 12 row and 12 byte cases, outside fallbacks, mirrors, mixed boundaries, source authentication and snapshot preservation.

Wine scene compares 700 altered-source White Flowers frames; production CLI creates, reuses and verifies 149 files. Static join leaves only 3,600 copied-code support bytes unowned in the E362 sample; all Wine servers drained.
limitations: The sample is address-only and does not establish full-ROM coverage or remove the copied-code dependency. Asset extents, ancestry, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements were made.
